Remark
[Largest curvature-controlled scale] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0090 ↗ def:chow-iii-weakly-kappa-noncollapsed 1. ch18:18.35\group Localized Noncollapsing

The function \[ \Psi (r)=r^2\max _{B_{g(t_0)}(x_0,r)\times [t_0-r^2,t_0]}|\Rm | \] is nondecreasing and tends to zero with $r$. If $\bar r$ is the largest radius on which $\Psi \le 1$, weak $\kappa $-noncollapsing below $\rho $ is equivalent to the volume lower bound for all $0<r\le \min \{ \rho ,\bar r\} $.
